annotations.title: utilpeek: encode or decode text (base64, hex, URL, ..., JWT decode)

description: utilpeek: Encode or decode text: base64, hex, URL, punycode, JWT decode, ... For digests use hash_text; for a JWT's claims use decode_jwt. Returns the text encoded or decoded with `codec`: base64, base64url, base32, hex, url (percent), html (entities), quoted_printable, rot13, punycode, idna or jwt. Decoders are strict (bad input is a 422 decode_failed); bytes that are not UTF-8 come back as `output_base64`. `jwt` is decode only: the header and payload are decoded and the signature is NEVER verified (every reply says `signature_verified: false`), so a decoded token proves nothing about who issued it; the token is never echoed back. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored.
